concrete_failure: With a U+2028 or U+2029 before selected f, TypeScript logical line mapping and LF-only quote splitting diverged. Two same-length f/g declarations reproduced selected f with g quotation in both optional tools.
fix: Reject literal Unicode line/paragraph separators anywhere in source before parsing. Existing LF and CRLF profiles remain supported; a literal separator within a string is intentionally also outside this bounded profile.
preservation: Version1.0.0 guard prototype and both tools in the immutable05:27:59Z capsule remain intact. That capsule predates this fix and must not be used as proof of Unicode-separator safety. A later capsule is required for1.0.1.
